name: default-hackathon-policy
notes: Devnet demo policy per PRD section 15: max 0.05 SOL/tx, 0.1 SOL total budget, Vendor A allowlisted only, SOL transfers (System Program) only, 2-hour expiry from issue. One-time use: an executed authorization (bound to the exact transaction content + policy version) cannot be replayed; retries after failure stay allowed.
